'''''Lish Runner VII''''' was a [[Passenger liner/Legends|passenger liner]] owned and operated by [[Lant Mining Corporation]]. The [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] was used to transport LMC workers between [[Lish]]'s [[Moon/Legends|moons]].
